🚀 Added an AI-written synopsis and plain-English change descriptions, with per-rule validation, retries, cached templates and fallbacks, plus GeoAnimator support in the product registry

🐛 Hardened the synopsis pipeline: stricter validation of observations and causes, name matching fixes, safer caching, partial salvage of good items after failed or timed-out calls, and no duplicated budget units

🚀 Reworked the ad-spend layout and recipients: fixed product order, idle lines folded into one 'No spend' line, no person named in the prose, and the scheduled email also goes to a second recipient. Email subjects and sender names were improved too, keeping the full decision in 'Needs you' subjects and splitting headline sentences more accurately
